تقتبسوا (form VIII)
# تَقْتَبِسُوا (taqtabisū) /taq.ta.bi.suː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَبَسَ (iqtabasa)
# تُقْتَبَسُوا (tuqtabasū) /tuq.ta.ba.suː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَبَسَ (iqtabasa)
